summary: Iteration 172 — 3-step Webstore Setup Wizard & CreationResult screen. All 12 acceptance criteria PASS. Frontend-only testing of the simplified wizard (type→basics→owner), creation result screen with questionnaire send, link fallback, skip/done, and existing store detail dialog.

design_issues.screen: CreationResult — Send Questionnaire button when no email
issues: Send button visually appears blue (not grayed-out) when disabled (no email). The disabled attribute IS correctly set (is_enabled()=False), but the button color doesn't visually communicate the disabled state. Minor cosmetic issue only.

critical_code_review_comments: wizard-submit-btn disabled condition uses canCreate = !['type','name','owner_name'].some(k => stepErrors[k]) — correctly requires all 3 before enabling Create Store.
CreationResult send button disabled={sending || !overrideEmail?.trim()} — correctly disabled when email is empty. Verified via is_enabled()=False.
CreationResult pre-populates overrideEmail from store.owner_email — correct flow so owner email from Step 3 auto-fills the questionnaire send field.

handleSendQuestionnaireAfterCreate returns {email_sent, link, email} — when email fails (SendGrid mocked in test env), email_sent is false and link is provided. CreationResult correctly shows questionnaire-link-fallback in this case.
handleCloseCreateDialog correctly sets createdStore=null AND resets form — verified by reopening wizard showing clean Step 1 with no pre-selection.
Event store created without any event/fundraiser/date fields — all deferred to questionnaire flow. Only 3 fields collected: store_type, name, owner info.
seed_data_creation: 4 TEST_ stores created during testing: TEST_WizardBusiness_AutoTest (business), TEST_WizardFundraiser_AutoTest (fundraiser), TEST_WizardEvent_AutoTest (event), TEST_NoEmail_CheckDisabled (business). All in pending state. Can be deleted via admin UI or DELETE /api/webstores/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-step wizard fully working. CreationResult screen with questionnaire flow fully working. SendGrid email fails in test env (mocked) → link fallback shows correctly with copyable questionnaire URL. Test stores created: TEST_WizardBusiness_AutoTest, TEST_WizardFundraiser_AutoTest, TEST_WizardEvent_AutoTest, TEST_NoEmail_CheckDisabled — all pending status. Store count was 50 before testing, now 54.

acceptance_criteria_results.1_wizard_3_steps_only: PASS — Exactly 3 step testids: wizard-step-type-*, wizard-step-basics-*, wizard-step-owner-*. No branding/dates/fulfillment/payments/review steps.
acceptance_criteria_results.2_create_button_enabled_when: PASS — Create Store button disabled until store_type + store name + owner name all filled. Email is optional.
acceptance_criteria_results.3_business_store_pending: PASS — Business store created in pending state with 3-step flow.
acceptance_criteria_results.4_fundraiser_store_pending: PASS — Fundraiser store created in pending state.
acceptance_criteria_results.5_event_store_pending_no_dates: PASS — Event store created without any event date fields. No event_start_date, order_deadline inputs in wizard.
acceptance_criteria_results.6_creation_result_screen: PASS — wizard-creation-result appears after creation. Dialog does NOT close immediately.
acceptance_criteria_results.7_result_shows_store_name_and_buttons: PASS — Store name, 'pending' state, send-questionnaire-btn, questionnaire-email-input all visible.
acceptance_criteria_results.8_send_questionnaire_api_call: PASS — Send Questionnaire button triggers sendWebstoreQuestionnaire API call.
acceptance_criteria_results.9_link_fallback_on_email_fail: PASS — When email fails (SendGrid mocked), questionnaire-link-fallback shows with questionnaire-copy-link and copy-link-btn.
acceptance_criteria_results.10_skip_closes_dialog: PASS — wizard-skip-questionnaire-btn closes dialog and form resets (confirmed by reopening showing fresh wizard).
acceptance_criteria_results.11_existing_stores_detail_dialog: PASS — Existing stores open in store-detail-dialog with Dashboard/Products/Settings tabs.
acceptance_criteria_results.12_cancel_closes_without_creating: PASS — wizard-cancel-btn closes dialog without creating store.
